title: AI, 5G upgrades lift Taiwan's top three telecoms in August

title: AI server exports to US slow; electronics parts jump 1.5 times in August
content: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance on September 9 said electronic parts exports reached US$32.22 billion in August 2026, a record monthly high, rising US$11.83 billion, or 58%, from the same month in 2025. Integrated circuits rose US$11.55 billion, up 60%, while printed circuit boards increased US$140 million, up nearly 30%.

title: AI server tracker: Taiwan optics race beyond 1.6T
content: Taiwan's optical communications supply chain is entering a more consequential phase of the AI infrastructure cycle. Demand is broadening beyond conventional pluggable transceivers toward continuous-wave (CW) lasers, fiber array units (FAUs), external laser sources and co-packaged optics (CPO), while transmission speeds advance from 800G and 1.6T toward 3.2T and beyond.

title: Delays trim CAEC August sales, but UPS demand outlook stays firm
content: Changs Ascending Enterprise (CAEC) said some shipments of lithium iron phosphate battery systems used in semiconductor uninterruptible power supply equipment were delayed after customers adjusted plant expansion schedules, and heavy rain in southern Taiwan slowed delivery and acceptance. August 2026 revenue fell from July, but still ranked as the second-highest August on record.

title: HannStar to halve panel output as layoffs and a management exit fuel closure talk
content: HannStar Display is preparing to cut output at its only fab roughly in half, alongside a workforce reduction that industry sources put at as much as 70% — being carried out through a voluntary buyout program. The moves landed in the same week its general manager resigned, turning long-running speculation about a plant closure into the central question around the company.
